entities.name: Pierre Soulé
entities.label: Person
entities.summary: Pierre Soulé was a French-born American attorney, politician, and diplomat in the mid-19th century. Serving as a U.S. senator from Louisiana from 1849 to 1853, he was nominated that year as U.S. Minister to Spain, a post that he held until 1855.
